name: computer_use__start_session
description: Declare a session — a named, color-coded identity for THIS agent run. Pass a stable `session` id; the agent cursor, per-session config, and recording all key on it, and it follows the run across any apps/windows. The cursor's color is derived from the id, so distinct runs are visually distinct. A cursor is shown only for a declared session — call this (or pass `session` on your first action) to opt in. Idempotent: re-calling with the same id just refreshes its idle-TTL. End it with `end_session` (or let the idle-TTL reclaim it). Concurrent runs/subagents each pass their own `session` to get their own cursor.

session.description: Stable session id for this run (e.g. "research-run-1").
